audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. a planar counterexample to Theorem B; a scale-dependent Gaussian translation; localization loses the \(99\%\) target
limitations: F1 — Counterevidence: No counterexample toA, L1 tangents, Jordan theorem or n>=2B. Null-set modification cannot preserve topological claim.

F2 — Counterevidence: Bare existential epsilon>.1 makes interval empty; finding concerns explicitly required epsilon<<lambda. Main rectifiability not refuted. Section3.2 uses constant c_psi; the shifted-reference halfspace display on PDF18 read literally yields a_plus=0 and a_minus=pi^((n+1)/2)erf(0.1), so the conclusion still fails for the minus sign. Equal values for both signs refer to Section3.2.
F3 — Counterevidence: Global horizontal graph exists in example; no counterexample to existence theorem or qualitative rectifiability. Illustrative balls need not be unique selection.
F4 — Counterevidence: Measurability itself is true; local proof route false.
F5 — Counterevidence: Later fixed kernels not refuted; could absorb fixednorm into kernel-dependent constant.
F6 — Counterevidence: Inequality itself valid; equality may conventionally be meant modulo capacity.
F7 — Counterevidence: Actualuse G=E capquarterB0 is localized; no refutation of localized theorem.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
